item.description:
Genre: Pop
Language: Latin Spanish, English, Italian, German & Castillian Spanish
Length: 3 hours, 12 min

ISABELLA CASTILLO also known as Bella C is a cuban-american popstar and actress mostly known for starring Nickelodeon's global hit TV series Grachi and also for playing the role of Diana Ahumada in Telemundo's Lord Of The Skies.

This is a compilation of all her songs, from the first to the last.
Extracted from Apple Music.
(1st disc is Lossless, 2nd disc is Lossy cause it's her first soundtrack album which isn't available in better quality, this is rare and i added it just in case you wanna hear literally her first album ever, recorded in Spain in 2008 while she was playing the role of Anne Frank)

ONLY MISSING SONGS:
Sed de Venganza (unreleased theme song off the Disney+ novela in which she stars)
Don't Let Me Down (song from Grachi, released online in 2011 but lost and i only have some secs preview)
El Son Is My Song (From The Musical ASSUCA!) - Song released in 2011 in Spain, included on the album "Un Disco Muy Especial"
